extraction.name: ArtifactsBench
extraction.description: A benchmark and automated, multimodal evaluation paradigm for visual code generation.
extraction.creator: Tencent Hunyuan Team
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Candidates were aggregated from expert showcases, open datasets, web case studies, and LLM visual-to-query from screenshots.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Expert showcases, openSVG/web-snippet datasets, web case studies, and LLM visual-to-query from screenshots.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Automated filters were used to drop incomplete, non-visual, license-violating, duplicate, trivial, or non-interactive items.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Each query is paired with a 10-dimension checklist covering visual, interactional, and code qualities, which are LLM-drafted and then human-refined.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: A 10% manually curated seed was used to anchor calibration, achieving a Cohen’s kappa of >= 0.8 among annotators.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The discrete sampling methodology may not fully capture the fluidity, correctness, and robustness of highly complex, long-horizon, or state-dependent interactions.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating LLMs on interactive visual artifacts.

name.evidence: we introduce ArtifactsBench, a benchmark and automated, multimodal evaluation paradigm for visual code generation.

description.evidence: we introduce ArtifactsBench, a benchmark and automated, multimodal evaluation paradigm for visual code generation.

url.evidence: We opensource ArtifactsBench, including the benchmark, evaluation hamess, and baseline results at https://artifactsbenchmark.github.io

rai:dataCollection.evidence: We aggregate candidates from expert showcases, openSVG/web-snippetdatasets, web case studies, andLLM visual-to-queryfrom screenshots.

rai:dataCollectionType.evidence: We aggregate candidates from expert showcases, openSVG/web-snippetdatasets, web case studies, andLLM visual-to-queryfrom screenshots.

rai:dataCollectionRawData.evidence: We aggregate candidates from expert showcases, openSVG/web-snippetdatasets, web case studies, andLLM visual-to-queryfrom screenshots.

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: Automated filters drop incomplete, non-visual, license-violating, duplicate, trivial, or non-interactive items, prioritizing dynamics (state changes, animations, responsiveness).

rai:dataAnnotationProtocol.evidence: Each query is paired with a10-dimensionchecklist covering visual, interactional, and code qualities. We LLM-draft and then human-refine for specificity and screenability.

rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis.evidence: A10% manually curated seed anchors calibration and achievesCohen’s κ≥0.8 among annotators

rai:machineAnnotationTools.evidence: Checklists are generated by Hunyuan-Turbos and human-refined

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: However, for highly complex, long-horizon, or state-dependent interactions (e.g., multi-step user workflows in a web application, or the nuanced physics in a game), this discrete sampling may not fully capture the fluidity, correctness, and robustness of the entire interactive experience.

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: we introduce ArtifactsBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on interactive visual artifacts.
